```{r}
create_dt <- function(x){
    DT::datatable(x,
                extensions = 'Buttons',
                options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                                buttons = list('copy', 'csv', list(extend = 'excel', title = NULL), 'pdf', 'print'),
                               # buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                               pageLength = 25,
                                lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                                    c(10,25,50,"All")),
                paging = TRUE
                ),
                filter = "top"
  )
}

colorPalette_08 = c("#2271B2","#F748A5","#359B73","#F0E442","#D55E00","#3DB7E9","#E69F00","#000000")
colorPalette_12 = c("#E20134","#00FCCF","#008DF9","#8400CD","#FFC33B","#9F0162","#009F81","#FF5AAF","#FF6E3A","#00C2F9","#FFB2FD","#A40122")
colorPalette_15 = c("#F60239","#003C86","#EF0096","#9400E6","#009FFA","#008169","#68023F","#00DCB5","#FFCFE2","#FF71FD","#7CFFFA","#6A0213","#008607","#00E307","#FFDC3D")

# commonly used functions
`%!in%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
is.notna <- function(x) {
  return(!is.na(x))
}
# tuning parameters
cell_w <- 0.25   # inches per column
cell_h <- 0.25   # inches per row

```


```{r}
sample_name_key = readr::read_tsv("meta/sample_name_key.tsv")
```

```{r}
allExtractionStats = readr::read_tsv("extractionReports/allExtractionStats.tsv.gz") %>%
  left_join(sample_name_key %>%
              dplyr::rename(sampleName = old_sample_name,
                            sample_name = new_sample_name)) %>%
  mutate(sample_name = ifelse(is.na(sample_name), sampleName, sample_name))

allExtractionStats_sample_fig_w <- max(6, n_distinct(allExtractionStats$sample_name) * cell_w)


allExtractionProfile = readr::read_tsv("extractionReports/allExtractionProfile.tsv.gz") %>%
  left_join(sample_name_key %>%
              dplyr::rename(sampleName = old_sample_name,
                            sample_name = new_sample_name)) %>%
  mutate(sample_name = ifelse(is.na(sample_name), sampleName, sample_name))

targets_name_key = tibble()
if(file.exists("finalResults/variantCalls/reports/info/targetsIntersectingWithGenesInfo.tsv")){
  targetsIntersectingWithGenesInfo = readr::read_tsv("finalResults/variantCalls/reports/info/targetsIntersectingWithGenesInfo.tsv") %>%
    mutate(new_target_name = ifelse(is.na(Name), paste0(target, "-", ID), paste0(target, "-", Name)))
  targets_name_key = targetsIntersectingWithGenesInfo %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(target, new_target_name) %>%
    unique() %>%
    bind_rows(
      allExtractionProfile %>%
        select(target) %>%
        unique() %>%
        filter(target %!in% targetsIntersectingWithGenesInfo$target) %>%
        mutate(new_target_name = target)
    )
} else {
  targets_name_key = allExtractionProfile %>%
        select(target) %>%
        unique() %>%
        mutate(new_target_name = target)
}

allExtractionProfile = allExtractionProfile %>%
  left_join(targets_name_key)


allExtractionProfile_sp = allExtractionProfile %>%
  filter(new_target_name  != "undetermined") %>%
  select(sample_name, new_target_name, good) %>%
  mutate(good = log10(good + 1)) %>%
  spread(new_target_name, good, fill = 0)

allExtractionProfile_sp_mat = as.matrix(allExtractionProfile_sp[,2:ncol(allExtractionProfile_sp)])
rownames(allExtractionProfile_sp_mat) = allExtractionProfile_sp$sample_name
allExtractionProfile_sp_mat_n_rows <- nrow(allExtractionProfile_sp_mat)
allExtractionProfile_sp_mat_n_cols <- ncol(allExtractionProfile_sp_mat)



allExtractionProfile_sp_mat_fig_w <- max(6, allExtractionProfile_sp_mat_n_cols * cell_w)
allExtractionProfile_sp_mat_fig_h <- max(6, allExtractionProfile_sp_mat_n_rows * cell_h)

```

```{r}
allSelectedClustersInfo = readr::read_tsv("finalResults/allSelectedClustersInfo.tsv.gz") %>%
  left_join(targets_name_key %>%
              dplyr::rename(p_name = target))

# HaplotypeRainbows v2.0.0: the package is now a single chainable R6 class.
# The column mapping is supplied once to $new(); this data uses SeekDeep names
# (the target column was renamed to new_target_name above).
allSelectedClustersInfo_rb = HaplotypeRainbows::HaplotypeRainbow$new(
  allSelectedClustersInfo,
  sample_col    = "s_Sample",
  target_col    = "new_target_name",
  popuid_col    = "h_popUID",
  rel_abund_col = "c_AveragedFrac"
)
allSelectedClustersInfo_rb$prep()
if(n_distinct(allSelectedClustersInfo$s_Sample) > 1){
  allSelectedClustersInfo_rb$sort_by_clustering()
}
allSelectedClustersInfo_plot = allSelectedClustersInfo_rb$plot()

# count-driven figure sizing (width scales with targets, height with samples)
allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_dims = allSelectedClustersInfo_rb$dims(
  cell_width = cell_w, cell_height = cell_h
)
allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_fig_w = allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_dims$width
allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_fig_h = allSelectedClustersInfo_prep_dims$height


```

```{r}
#| title: "Raw read counts"
#| fig-width: !expr allExtractionStats_sample_fig_w

read_count_colors = c("Total" = colorPalette_08[1], "used" = colorPalette_08[2])

ggplotly(
  ggplot(allExtractionStats) +
    geom_col(aes(x = sample_name,
                 y = Total,
                 fill = "Total"), color = "black")  +
    geom_col(aes(x = sample_name,
                 y = used,
                 fill = "used"), color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = read_count_colors) +
    labs(y = "reads")
)
```


```{r}
#| title: "Percent read counts"
#| fig-width: !expr allExtractionStats_sample_fig_w

ggplotly(
  ggplot(allExtractionStats %>%
           mutate(usedFrac = used/Total)) +
    geom_col(aes(x = sample_name,
                 y = usedFrac,
                 fill = "used"), color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = read_count_colors) +
    labs(y = "reads") +
    ylim(0,1)
)
```

```{r}
#| title: Known mutations within sample info table

if(file.exists("finalResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")){
  AAChangesInfo = readr::read_tsv("finalResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")

  AAChangesInfo_targeted = AAChangesInfo %>%
    filter(Targeted == "Yes") %>%
    filter(AA_cnt > 0) %>%
    select(-Gene_Transcript_ID, -ExonicFunc, -Mutation_Name, -CoveredBy, -Targeted)
  create_dt(AAChangesInfo_targeted)
}
```

```{r}
#| title: Known mutations frequency and prevalence table

AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_fig_w = 10
if(file.exists("finalResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")){
  AAChangesInfo = readr::read_tsv("finalResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")

  AAChangesInfo_targeted_population = AAChangesInfo %>%
    filter(Targeted == "Yes") %>%
    filter(AA_cnt > 0) %>%
    select(Gene_ID, Gene, AA_Change, reference_AA_pos, reference_AA, AA, is_reference, AlleleCount, AlleleFrequency, SampleCount, SamplePrevalence) %>%
    unique()
  AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_fig_w = n_distinct(paste0(AAChangesInfo_targeted_population$Gene_ID, "-", AAChangesInfo_targeted_population$reference_AA_pos))
  create_dt(AAChangesInfo_targeted_population)
}
```

```{r}
#| title: Known mutations prevalence plot
#| fig-width: !expr AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_fig_w

if(file.exists("finalResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")){
  AAChangesInfo = readr::read_tsv("finalResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz")

  AAChangesInfo_targeted= AAChangesInfo %>%
    filter(Targeted == "Yes") %>%
    filter(AA_cnt > 0) %>%
    group_by(Gene, Gene_ID, reference_AA_pos, sample) %>%
    mutate(genotype = case_when(
      all(!is_reference) ~ "alt",
      all(is_reference) ~ "ref",
      T ~ "mixed"
    ))
  AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_genotype_count = AAChangesInfo_targeted %>%
    group_by(Gene, Gene_ID, reference_AA_pos) %>%
    mutate(position_sample_total = n_distinct(sample)) %>%
    group_by(Gene, Gene_ID, reference_AA_pos, position_sample_total, genotype) %>%
    summarise(sample_count = n_distinct(sample)) %>%
    mutate(sample_prev = sample_count/position_sample_total) %>%
    group_by(Gene, Gene_ID) %>%
    mutate(Identifier = paste0(Gene, "-", Gene_ID, "-", stringr::str_pad(reference_AA_pos, max(nchar(reference_AA_pos))))) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplotly(ggplot(AAChangesInfo_targeted_population_genotype_count) +
    geom_col(aes(x = Identifier, y = sample_prev, fill = genotype, sample_count = sample_count), color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colorPalette_08))
}
```
